vulnerable_statements.reason: If st_dwc3_drd_init() fails after of_platform_populate() has already created and registered the child dwc3 core platform device(s), the error path only asserts the resets and returns. It never calls of_platform_depopulate(), so the child devices stay registered and leak. They keep running against hardware that is now held in reset, and the parent probe has failed.
When of_find_device_by_node() fails (line 75), the populated child devices are not depopulated before the function returns. That leaks the devices created by of_platform_populate().

suggested_fix: Add an error label such as 'depopulate:' that calls of_platform_depopulate(dev) and then falls through to the reset-assert cleanup. Jump to it from every failure that happens after of_platform_populate() succeeds: the of_find_device_by_node() failure (put the child node there too) and the st_dwc3_drd_init() failure. This tears down the child devices on every probe error path.
